items.title: Can a $68 Billion Payout Save UNH Stock?
items.summary: The healthcare giant sent a fortune back to its owners, but the market yawned. Here’s the real accounting of what that cash bought, and what it didn't.

items.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks with Competitive Advantages and 1 That Underwhelm
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

items.title: Humana-owned Villages Health agrees to $542M settlement for overbilling Medicare
items.summary: The Central Florida provider manufactured fake diagnosis codes for its Medicare Advantage patients from 2020 to 2024, the DOJ said. Humana bought The Villages Health last year.

items.title: Here's Why Investors Should Retain Humana Stock for Now
items.summary: HUM benefits from Medicare Advantage growth, CenterWell expansion and strong cash generation, but rising costs and debt remain concerns.

items.title: DVA & Humana Expand Value-Based Care for Kidney Disease Patients
items.summary: DaVita expands its Humana partnership to earlier-stage kidney disease, bringing value-based care to over 10,000 Medicare Advantage members.

items.title: Monogram Health to pay $2.4M to settle Medicare Advantage upcoding allegations
items.summary: Monogram, a home health company, overcharged Medicare through contracts with Cigna and Humana by inflating diagnostic codes, according to the Justice Department.

items.title: Humana (HUM) Backs 1,000 Indiana Home Health Aide Scholarships
items.summary: Humana (NYSE:HUM) is sponsoring 1,000 Home Health Aide scholarships in Indiana and launching a broad collaboration with HealthStream to address caregiver shortages. The effort targets recruitment, training and retention of home-based caregivers, with a focus on underserved and rural communities. The program aims to support quality and continuity of home-based care as demand for in home services grows. Explore other healthcare stocks that are investing in workforce capacity, digital tools...

items.title: Can Humana (HUM) Stay Cheap If Medicare Advantage Margins Tighten?
items.summary: Humana stock has delivered a strong 46.2% return year to date, yet the valuation checks paint a mixed picture that leaves investors weighing how much of the story is already reflected in the price. Year to date, Humana is up 46.2%, which puts recent gains front and centre for anyone assessing what the current valuation implies.
